## Frequently asked questions

### How many guests can SRK Mahal hold?
SRK Mahal seats up to 400 guests.

### Where is SRK Mahal?
G-53, Drowpathy Amman Koil Street, Vanuvampet, Madipakkam, Chennai 600 091.

### What facilities does SRK Mahal have?
Catering services, Hall decoration, Flower garlands, Music & DJ, Security & valet parking, Weddings & receptions, Engagements, Seemantham, Upanayanam, Ayush homam, Meetings & conferences.

### Does SRK Mahal arrange decoration?
Yes. Hall decoration, flower garlands, catering, music and DJ can all be arranged by SRK Mahal.

### What functions can I hold here?
Weddings and receptions, engagements, seemantham, upanayanam, ayush homam, and meetings and conferences.

### How do I check if SRK Mahal is free on my date?
